scope: Student portal auth, actions, access route and dashboard boundary; not full PR210 review.

findings.issue: Order-scoped buyer support capability is exchanged for an email-wide student session without proving mailbox ownership.
findings.evidence: Action resolves an order grant, decrypts its buyer email, issues checkout_redirect; access route accepts that purpose and sets a vendor/customerKeyHash session. Dashboard queries every paid/refunded order with the same tenant and customerKeyHash. Current checkout issues buyer grant to its requesting browser.
findings.impact: A checkout made with another student email can cross the intended order scope when this source is ported.
findings.recommended_fix: Require a mailbox-delivered single-use magic link before granting account-wide portal access. Checkout may navigate to login; an order grant must remain limited to that order.
findings.required_test: Two orders share an email; browser possesses only the newer order grant. Checkout entry must not create portal session or access the other order. Only consuming the emailed capability can authenticate.
findings.verification: Isolated mocked Server Action regression reproduces the unexpected checkout capability issue; fixed candidate redirects to verified login. Not an end-to-end exploit.

findings.issue: NODE_ENV non-production returns a valid login capability directly to an unauthenticated caller.
findings.evidence: After account lookup, the action returns mockLink before email delivery whenever NODE_ENV is not production.
findings.impact: Any accessible development server with seeded or non-isolated data bypasses mailbox verification. Preview builds normally set production, so this is not a claim that every Preview deployment is affected.
findings.recommended_fix: Queue email consistently; browser tests capture a synthetic local mail sink internally instead of exposing the capability in action response.
findings.required_test: No response contains mockLink under development, test or production; synthetic mail sink only exists inside local test harness.
findings.verification: Mocked action regressions reproduce capability disclosure under development and test. Fixed candidate queues encrypted email in all three environments.

findings.issue: Temporal validation rejects expiry but does not reject future issuance; session validation also does not require positive duration.
findings.evidence: Access verifies expiresAt > now and exact TTL. Session verifies expiry and duration <= max only.
findings.impact: Malformed but authenticated payloads can pass temporal policy; no unsigned token forgery is claimed.
findings.recommended_fix: Require issuedAt <= now and expiresAt > issuedAt, keeping existing max TTL and exact token TTL.
findings.required_test: Future-issued signed/encrypted payloads and nonpositive session duration fail closed.
findings.verification: Four added synthetic temporal tests fail against exact source and pass against candidate; original seven auth tests also pass with deterministic clock.

milestone.deliver: Email-verified login, tenant-bound dashboard, existing encrypted delivery snapshots, bookings/calendar, vouchers and invoices. Checkout navigates to verified login.
milestone.dependencies: New StudentPortalAccessToken Prisma model/migration, email delivery queue, CSRF, public login route and browser tests.
milestone.later: Native course lessons/progress/certificate, community, multilingual/PWA additions require separate dependencies and functional acceptance.
